title: order
description: The message schema to communicate orders from fleet control to the mobile robot.

headerId.description: headerId of the message. The headerId is defined per topic and incremented by 1 with each sent (but not necessarily received) message.

serialNumber.description: Serial number of the mobile robot.

orderId.description: Order Identification. This is to be used to identify multiple order messages that belong to the same order.

orderUpdateId.description: Order update identification. It is unique per orderId, starting at 0 for a new order. If an order update is rejected, this field shall be passed in the rejection message.

orderDescription.description: Additional human-readable information only for visualization purposes; this shall not be used for any logical processes.

nodes.description: Array of nodes objects to be traversed for fulfilling the order. One node is enough for a valid order. Leave edge list empty for that case.

edges.description: Directional connection between two nodes. Array of edge objects to be traversed for fulfilling the order. One node is enough for a valid order. Leave edge list empty for that case.
